recipes.name: Amaretti Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy Italian almond cookies with a lightly crisp sugar crust.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a tray with parchment paper.
Whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt, add the sugar gradually, and fold in the almond flour, flour, and almond extract to form a thick dough.
Roll small portions in powdered sugar, flatten lightly, and bake until cracked and just set.

image.alt: Amaretti Cookies plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Banana Cake
recipes.description: A moist loaf-style banana cake with chocolate folded through the batter.

steps.instruction: Mash the bananas and whisk them with the eggs, sugars, and melted butter.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, and chocolate until the batter is evenly mixed.
Pour into a loaf pan and bake until the center is set and lightly golden.

image.alt: Banana Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Coconut Bean Rice Balls
recipes.description: Steamed glutinous rice dumplings with a sweet bean and coconut filling.

steps.instruction: Blend the soybeans with sugar, egg yolks, coconut cream, and coconut, then cook briefly if needed until the filling holds its shape.
Mix the glutinous rice flour with warm sweetened water and oil to form a soft dough, then wrap portions around the filling.
Steam the balls until translucent, brush lightly with water, and roll in coconut before serving.

image.alt: Coconut Bean Rice Balls plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Banana Peanut Butter Brownies
recipes.description: A flour-light brownie sweetened with banana and enriched with peanut butter.

steps.instruction: Mash the bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, peanut butter, cocoa, and vanilla.
Fold in the chocolate chips and spread the batter into a lined square pan.
Bake until the center is just set, then cool before slicing.

image.alt: Banana Peanut Butter Brownies plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Soft spiral buns with cinnamon filling and cream cheese glaze.

steps.instruction: Mix warm milk, yeast, eggs, butter, sugar, and flour into a soft dough, then let it rise until doubled.
Roll the dough out, spread with butter and cinnamon sugar, then roll up and slice into buns.
Bake until golden and finish with a cream cheese glaze once slightly cooled.

image.alt: Cinnamon Rolls plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: American Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Large bakery-style cookies with brown sugar, honey, and milk chocolate chips.

steps.instruction: Mix the dry ingredients in one bowl and whisk the melted butter with egg and honey in another.
Combine the wet and dry mixtures, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Shape large cookies and bake until the edges are set and the centers remain soft.

image.alt: American Chocolate Chip Cookies plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Crema Catalana
recipes.description: A citrus-and-cinnamon scented custard with a thin caramelized sugar top.

ingredients.name: lemon zest
ingredients.notes: use lemon and lime if available

steps.instruction: Infuse the hot milk with cinnamon and citrus zest, then strain it.
Whisk the yolks with sugar and cornstarch, then cook with the infused milk until thickened.
Chill the custards thoroughly, sprinkle with sugar, and caramelize just before serving.

image.alt: Crema Catalana plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Sweet Crepes
recipes.description: Thin French crepes that can be served with sugar, citrus, or jam.

ingredients.name: beer
ingredients.notes: optional but traditional in the source

steps.instruction: Whisk the eggs and gradually add the flour and milk until the batter is smooth, then stir in the beer and zest.
Rest the batter so the flour fully hydrates and thin it with a little water if needed.
Cook thin ladlefuls in a lightly buttered skillet, flipping once the edges color.

image.alt: Sweet Crepes plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chocolate Mascarpone Fondant
recipes.description: A rich, low-flour chocolate cake finished with a glossy chocolate glaze.

steps.instruction: Melt the dark chocolate, whisk it into softened mascarpone, then add eggs one at a time.
Fold in powdered sugar and flour, pour into a pan, and bake gently until just set.
Cool the cake completely, then spread over the milk-chocolate butter glaze before slicing.

image.alt: Chocolate Mascarpone Fondant plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Fromage Blanc Cake
recipes.description: A light farmhouse cheesecake-style cake with a softly set creamy crumb.

steps.instruction: Mix the fromage blanc with sugar, egg yolks, flour, and vanilla or citrus until smooth.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them gently into the batter.
Bake until set, then let the cake cool slowly in the oven before chilling or serving.

image.alt: Fromage Blanc Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Praline Grand Cru Cake
recipes.description: A celebration cake layered with hazelnut sponge, praline mousse, ganache, and glaze.

ingredients.name: milk chocolate
ingredients.notes: used across the layers and glaze

steps.instruction: Bake the hazelnut sponge and cover it with the crunchy praline biscuit layer.
Prepare the praline ganache and mousse, then assemble them over the sponge in a ring mold and chill until firm.
Finish with the milk-chocolate mirror glaze and toasted nuts once the cake is fully set.

image.alt: Praline Grand Cru Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Jam Swiss Roll
recipes.description: A flexible sponge cake rolled around a layer of jam or other filling.

steps.instruction: Whip the egg whites separately, beat the yolks with sugar, and fold everything together with the flour.
Spread the batter thinly on a prepared tray and bake briefly until the sponge is just golden.
Turn it onto a damp towel, roll to shape, then unroll, spread with jam, and roll again.

image.alt: Jam Swiss Roll plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Fer a Cheval Cookies
recipes.description: Buttery sliced cookies rich with ground nuts and vanilla sugar.

steps.instruction: Cream the butter with the sugars, then work in the flour and finely chopped nuts to form a dough.
Shape the dough into logs or crescents and chill briefly so they hold their shape.
Bake until lightly colored and crisp at the edges.

image.alt: Fer a Cheval Cookies plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chocolate Banana Loaf
recipes.description: A soft banana cake dotted with chocolate and finished in a loaf tin.

steps.instruction: Saute the sliced bananas briefly in butter, then let them cool.
Whisk the eggs and sugars, stir in flour, baking powder, melted butter, rum, and chopped chocolate, then fold in the bananas.
Bake in a loaf pan until browned and fully cooked through.

image.alt: Chocolate Banana Loaf plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Almond Cake
recipes.description: A tender apple cake perfumed with cinnamon and finished with sliced almonds.

steps.instruction: Whisk the eggs, sugar, melted butter, flour, baking powder, and cinnamon into a smooth batter.
Fold in diced apples and pour the mixture into a prepared cake pan, then scatter almonds over the top.
Bake until golden and springy in the center.

image.alt: Apple Cinnamon Almond Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Mug Cookie Cake
recipes.description: A quick microwave cookie-style cake with a molten chocolate center.

steps.instruction: Melt the butter with most of the chocolate in a mug or small bowl.
Stir in the sugar, egg, flour, baking powder, and the remaining chopped chocolate until smooth.
Microwave until puffed and just cooked, keeping the center soft.

image.alt: Mug Cookie Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chestnut Cream Mug Cake
recipes.description: A soft microwave sponge flavored with sweet chestnut spread.

steps.instruction: Melt the butter, then whisk in the chestnut cream, milk, sugar, flour, and baking powder.
Beat in the egg until the batter is smooth and divide it between two mugs.
Microwave in short bursts until the cakes rise and the tops are no longer wet.

image.alt: Chestnut Cream Mug Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes that cook up quickly and stay tender inside.

steps.instruction: Whisk the eggs, milk, and melted butter together, then add the flour, sugar, and baking powder to make a smooth batter.
Rest the batter briefly if you want extra fluffy pancakes.
Cook ladlefuls on a lightly greased griddle until bubbles form, then flip and finish the second side.

image.alt: Pancakes plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: An upside-down caramelized apple tart baked under a crisp puff pastry lid.

steps.instruction: Make a caramel in the pan or mold, then cook the apple quarters with butter, sugar, and vanilla until tender.
Pack the apples into the mold, top with puff pastry, and tuck the edges in.
Bake until the pastry is golden, then turn the tart out while still warm.

image.alt: Tarte Tatin plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Burger Buns
recipes.description: Soft enriched sesame buns that stay tender enough for burgers and sandwiches.

steps.instruction: Mix the yeast with lukewarm water, then knead it with the flour, egg, butter, sugar, and salt until smooth.
Let the dough rise, divide it into buns, shape them tightly, and proof again on a tray.
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and bake until evenly browned.

image.alt: Burger Buns plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pasta alla Carbonara
recipes.description: Roman-style pasta coated in eggs, cheese, pepper, and crisp guanciale.

steps.instruction: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente while crisping the guanciale in a skillet.
Whisk the eggs with grated cheese and a generous amount of black pepper.
Combine the hot pasta with the guanciale and egg mixture off the heat, loosening with pasta water until glossy.

image.alt: Pasta alla Carbonara plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Lasagne alla Bolognese
recipes.description: Layered pasta with slow-cooked meat ragù, béchamel, and cheese.

steps.instruction: Cook the ragù with the meat, tomatoes, aromatics, and wine until thick and deeply flavored.
Prepare the béchamel and season it with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Layer pasta, ragù, béchamel, and cheeses, then bake until bubbling and browned.

image.alt: Lasagne alla Bolognese plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
recipes.description: Rice noodles stir-fried with chicken, tofu, eggs, peanuts, and bright finishing flavors.

steps.instruction: Soak the noodles until pliable and mix the sauce ingredients together.
Stir-fry the chicken and tofu, add the noodles and sauce, then scramble the eggs into the pan.
Finish with peanuts, bean sprouts, green onions, and lime wedges.

image.alt: Chicken Pad Thai plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pizza Dough
recipes.description: A straightforward yeasted dough for one large thin-crust pizza.

steps.instruction: Bloom the yeast with a little water, sugar, and flour, then let it sit until foamy.
Mix the starter with the remaining flour, water, salt, and olive oil, then knead until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise until doubled, stretch it out, and bake topped as desired.

image.alt: Pizza Dough plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Fresh Egg Pasta
recipes.description: Silky homemade pasta dough for tagliatelle, lasagnette, or filled shapes.

steps.instruction: Mix the flour and semolina, then work in the eggs until a firm dough comes together.
Knead until smooth, wrap, and let the dough rest before rolling it through a pasta machine.
Cut the sheets into your chosen shape and boil briefly, then finish with butter, herbs, or another sauce.

image.alt: Fresh Egg Pasta plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chorizo Savory Loaf
recipes.description: A simple savory quick bread packed with chorizo and cheese.

steps.instruction: Whisk the eggs with the milk, then add flour and baking powder to form a thick batter.
Fold in the cheese and chopped chorizo until evenly distributed.
Bake in a loaf tin until puffed and deeply golden.

image.alt: Chorizo Savory Loaf plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chorizo Bread Rolls
recipes.description: Small yeasted rolls laminated with slices of chorizo and finished with coarse salt.

steps.instruction: Knead the dough ingredients until smooth and let the dough rise until doubled.
Roll the dough out, scatter over the chopped chorizo, roll it up, and cut it into equal pieces.
Shape into rolls, brush with olive oil, sprinkle with coarse salt, and bake until browned.

image.alt: Chorizo Bread Rolls plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: A classic custard tart filled with bacon and cheese in a buttery crust.

steps.instruction: Line a tart pan with the pastry and preheat the oven.
Whisk the eggs with cream, then stir in the bacon and cheese.
Pour the filling into the shell and bake until the center is just set.

image.alt: Quiche Lorraine plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chorizo Pinwheels
recipes.description: Puff pastry spirals filled with chorizo, tomato, egg, and cheese.

steps.instruction: Blend the chorizo with the cheese, egg, and tomato sauce into a spreadable filling.
Spread the filling over the pastry, roll it up tightly, and chill briefly to firm.
Slice into rounds and bake until the pastry is puffed and crisp.

image.alt: Chorizo Pinwheels plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: A Neapolitan-style pizza topped simply with tomato, mozzarella, and basil.

steps.instruction: Stretch the dough into a thin round and spread over a light layer of crushed tomatoes.
Top with torn mozzarella and bake in a very hot oven until the crust blisters.
Finish with basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.

image.alt: Margherita Pizza plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Risotto alla Milanese
recipes.description: Creamy saffron risotto finished with butter and Parmesan.

steps.instruction: Saute the onion in half the butter, add the rice, and toast it lightly.
Add saffron and ladle in the hot stock gradually, stirring until the rice is creamy and tender.
Finish with the remaining butter and Parmesan just before serving.

image.alt: Risotto alla Milanese plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
recipes.description: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with fresh tomatoes and basil.

steps.instruction: Toast the bread slices until crisp and rub them with the garlic clove.
Mix diced tomatoes with basil, olive oil, and salt.
Spoon the tomato mixture over the toast and serve immediately.

image.alt: Bruschetta al Pomodoro plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans and pasta.

ingredients.name: mixed diced vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as onion, carrot, celery, zucchini

steps.instruction: Saute the vegetables in olive oil until softened.
Add tomatoes, beans, and stock, then simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Cook the pasta in the soup, adjust seasoning, and serve with olive oil or Parmesan if desired.

image.alt: Minestrone plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pesto alla Genovese
recipes.description: A raw basil sauce blended with pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic, and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, and Parmesan until finely chopped.
Stream in the olive oil until the sauce is smooth but still vibrant green.
Use immediately with pasta or refrigerate with a thin film of oil on top.

image.alt: Pesto alla Genovese plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.description: An airy coffee-soaked dessert layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa.

steps.instruction: Whisk the egg yolks with sugar, fold in mascarpone, and then fold in whipped egg whites.
Dip the ladyfingers briefly in espresso and layer them with the mascarpone cream.
Chill until set and dust generously with cocoa before serving.

image.alt: Tiramisu plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Schnitzel
recipes.description: Thin cutlets breaded and fried until crisp and deeply golden.

steps.instruction: Pound the cutlets thinly, then season them with salt and pepper.
Coat each cutlet in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides and serve immediately.

image.alt: Schnitzel plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: German Potato Salad
recipes.description: A warm tangy salad of potatoes, bacon, vinegar, and mustard.

steps.instruction: Boil the potatoes until tender, then slice them while still warm.
Cook the bacon and onion, then stir in vinegar, mustard, and a splash of water to make the dressing.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing and let them absorb the flavor before serving.

image.alt: German Potato Salad plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Soft Pretzels
recipes.description: Chewy baked pretzels with a dark crust and a salty finish.

steps.instruction: Knead the dough until smooth and let it rise until doubled in size.
Shape the dough into pretzels, dip them briefly in a baking-soda bath, and score the thick part.
Sprinkle with salt and bake until deeply browned.

image.alt: Soft Pretzels plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Black Forest Cake
recipes.description: Chocolate sponge layered with cherries and whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Bake or prepare the chocolate sponge layers and let them cool fully.
Whip the cream with sugar and macerate the cherries with kirsch if using.
Layer sponge, cherries, and cream, then coat the cake and chill before slicing.

image.alt: Black Forest Cake plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Currywurst
recipes.description: Sliced sausage with a spiced tomato sauce and a shower of curry powder.

steps.instruction: Brown the sausages until cooked through and slice them into bite-size pieces.
Simmer the ketchup with tomato puree, curry powder, paprika, and a splash of water to make the sauce.
Coat the sausage pieces in sauce and finish with extra curry powder before serving.

image.alt: Currywurst plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Classic Cheeseburger
recipes.description: A griddled beef burger served in a soft bun with cheese and crisp toppings.

steps.instruction: Shape the beef into patties and season them well.
Cook the patties on a hot griddle, adding cheese near the end so it melts.
Toast the buns and assemble with sauce, lettuce, tomato, and the hot patties.

image.alt: Classic Cheeseburger plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: A creamy baked pasta casserole with a browned cheesy crust.

steps.instruction: Cook the macaroni until just shy of done.
Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in the milk, and melt in most of the cheese.
Fold the pasta into the sauce, top with the remaining cheese and breadcrumbs, and bake until bubbling.

image.alt: Baked Mac and Cheese plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Buffalo Wings
recipes.description: Crisp chicken wings tossed in a buttery hot sauce.

steps.instruction: Bake or air-fry the wings until crisp and cooked through.
Warm the hot sauce with the butter and garlic powder until emulsified.
Toss the wings in the sauce and serve immediately with celery.

image.alt: Buffalo Wings plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich
recipes.description: Slow-cooked pork shoulder shredded into smoky barbecue sauce.

steps.instruction: Season the pork shoulder and cook it low and slow until it pulls apart easily.
Shred the meat and toss it with barbecue sauce, onion, and vinegar.
Pile the pork onto soft buns and serve hot.

image.alt: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: American Apple Pie
recipes.description: A double-crust pie filled with spiced apples and baked until bubbling.

steps.instruction: Toss the sliced apples with sugar and cinnamon and line a pie dish with one crust.
Fill the crust, dot with butter, and cover with the top crust, sealing and venting it.
Bake until the filling bubbles and the pastry is deeply golden.

image.alt: American Apple Pie plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Old Fashioned
recipes.description: A whiskey cocktail sweetened with sugar and perfumed with citrus and bitters.

steps.instruction: Muddle the sugar cube with bitters and a few drops of water in a rocks glass.
Add ice and pour over the whiskey, then stir until chilled.
Express the orange peel over the drink and drop it into the glass.

image.alt: Old Fashioned plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tortilla Espanola
recipes.description: A thick potato omelet served warm or at room temperature.

steps.instruction: Cook the sliced potatoes and onion gently in olive oil until tender but not browned.
Mix them with beaten eggs and return the mixture to the pan.
Cook slowly on both sides until the tortilla is set through.

image.alt: Tortilla Espanola plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.description: A chilled tomato soup blended with cucumber, pepper, and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, soaked bread, olive oil, and vinegar until completely smooth.
Season with salt and chill until very cold.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and finely diced vegetables if desired.

image.alt: Gazpacho plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Patatas Bravas
recipes.description: Crisp fried potatoes served with a punchy tomato-paprika sauce.

steps.instruction: Roast or fry the potato cubes until deeply crisp on the outside.
Simmer the tomato sauce with garlic and smoked paprika until bold and slightly thick.
Spoon the bravas sauce over the potatoes and serve hot.

image.alt: Patatas Bravas plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Seafood Paella
recipes.description: Saffron rice cooked in a wide pan with shrimp, mussels, and peppers.

steps.instruction: Saute the pepper and aromatics, then stir in the rice and saffron.
Add the stock and cook without stirring too much, arranging the seafood over the rice as it cooks.
Let the rice finish until tender with a slightly crisp socarrat on the bottom.

image.alt: Seafood Paella plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Sangria
recipes.description: A fruit-filled red wine punch chilled and lightly sparkling.

steps.instruction: Slice the fruit and combine it with the wine and orange juice.
Chill the mixture so the fruit infuses the wine.
Top with sparkling water just before serving over ice.

image.alt: Sangria plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: A crisp village salad with tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta.

steps.instruction: Cut the vegetables into large rustic pieces and place them in a bowl.
Add the olives and feta, then drizzle over olive oil and a little vinegar if desired.
Season simply and serve immediately.

image.alt: Greek Salad plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.description: A baked casserole of eggplant, spiced meat, and creamy bechamel.

steps.instruction: Roast or fry the eggplant slices until tender.
Cook the meat with tomatoes and spices into a thick sauce, then prepare the bechamel.
Layer eggplant and meat in a baking dish, cover with bechamel, and bake until browned.

image.alt: Moussaka plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tzatziki
recipes.description: A cool yogurt dip flavored with cucumber, garlic, and dill.

steps.instruction: Grate and squeeze the cucumber dry so the dip stays thick.
Mix the cucumber with yogurt, garlic, dill, and olive oil.
Chill before serving for the best texture and flavor.

image.alt: Tzatziki plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.description: Crisp phyllo pastry filled with spinach, herbs, and feta.

steps.instruction: Cook the spinach down and squeeze out the excess moisture, then mix it with feta and egg.
Layer oiled phyllo sheets in a pan, add the filling, and cover with more phyllo.
Score the top and bake until golden and crisp.

image.alt: Spanakopita plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.description: A chunky avocado dip brightened with lime, onion, and cilantro.

steps.instruction: Mash the avocados lightly so the texture stays chunky.
Fold in the lime juice, onion, cilantro, and jalapeno.
Season with salt and serve immediately.

image.alt: Guacamole plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tacos al Pastor
recipes.description: Corn tortillas filled with marinated pork, onion, cilantro, and pineapple.

steps.instruction: Marinate the pork with achiote, citrus, and spices, then grill or roast it until cooked through.
Slice the meat thinly and warm the tortillas.
Assemble the tacos with pork, pineapple, onion, and cilantro.

image.alt: Tacos al Pastor plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Rolled tortillas baked in red sauce with chicken and cheese.

steps.instruction: Fill the tortillas with chicken and a little onion, then roll them up in a baking dish.
Cover with enchilada sauce and grated cheese.
Bake until hot and bubbling, then serve with fresh toppings if desired.

image.alt: Chicken Enchiladas plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pico de Gallo
recipes.description: A fresh salsa of tomatoes, onion, chile, lime, and cilantro.

steps.instruction: Dice the tomatoes, onion, and jalapeno very finely.
Mix everything with lime juice and cilantro.
Season with salt and let it sit for a few minutes before serving.

image.alt: Pico de Gallo plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Margarita
recipes.description: A lime-forward tequila cocktail with a salt rim.

steps.instruction: Rim a glass with salt if desired.
Shake the tequila, triple sec, and lime juice with ice until very cold.
Strain into the prepared glass and serve immediately.

image.alt: Margarita plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken simmered in a silky tomato-butter sauce.

steps.instruction: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and spices, then sear it until lightly browned.
Simmer the tomato puree with butter and spices to build the sauce.
Return the chicken to the pan, add the cream, and cook until tender and glossy.

image.alt: Butter Chicken plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.description: A warmly spiced chickpea curry with tomato, onion, and ginger.

steps.instruction: Cook the onion until golden, then add garlic, ginger, and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer until thickened.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook until the flavors have fully blended.

image.alt: Chana Masala plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Samosas
recipes.description: Fried pastry pockets filled with spiced potatoes and peas.

steps.instruction: Make a firm dough with flour, oil, salt, and water, then let it rest.
Cook the potatoes and peas with the spices to make a dry filling.
Shape the dough into cones, fill them, seal them well, and fry until crisp.

image.alt: Samosas plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Naan
recipes.description: Soft skillet-flatbread brushed with butter and ready for curries.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients and knead until smooth, then let the dough rise.
Divide into balls and roll each into an oval flatbread.
Cook in a hot pan or oven until puffed and blistered, then brush with butter.

image.alt: Naan plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
recipes.description: A chilled yogurt drink blended with sweet mango and cardamom.

steps.instruction: Blend the mango with yogurt, milk, sugar, and cardamom until smooth.
Adjust the thickness with more milk if needed.
Serve very cold.

image.alt: Mango Lassi plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant coconut curry with green curry paste, vegetables, and herbs.

steps.instruction: Fry the curry paste briefly in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken, remaining coconut milk, and vegetables, then simmer until tender.
Season with fish sauce and finish with Thai basil.

image.alt: Thai Green Curry plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Som Tam
recipes.description: A crunchy green papaya salad dressed with lime, fish sauce, and chili.

steps.instruction: Shred the papaya and cut the beans into short lengths.
Pound the aromatics lightly and mix them with lime juice and fish sauce to form the dressing.
Toss everything together and finish with peanuts.

image.alt: Som Tam plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Thai Iced Tea
recipes.description: Strong black tea sweetened and topped with creamy milk over ice.

steps.instruction: Brew the tea strongly and dissolve the sugar while it is still hot.
Cool the tea and pour it over glasses filled with ice.
Top with sweetened condensed milk so it ribbons through the drink.

image.alt: Thai Iced Tea plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Miso Soup
recipes.description: A light dashi broth with miso, tofu, and scallions.

steps.instruction: Bring the dashi to a gentle simmer with tofu and wakame.
Dissolve the miso in a little hot broth, then stir it back into the pot off the boil.
Finish with sliced scallions and serve immediately.

image.alt: Miso Soup plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Pan-glazed chicken coated in a sweet-salty soy sauce glaze.

steps.instruction: Brown the chicken thighs skin-side down until the fat renders.
Pour in the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and ginger.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce turns glossy and syrupy.

image.alt: Chicken Teriyaki plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Shoyu Ramen
recipes.description: A soy-seasoned noodle soup with broth, toppings, and springy wheat noodles.

steps.instruction: Simmer the stock with soy sauce and aromatics to build the soup base.
Cook the noodles separately until just tender.
Assemble bowls with noodles, hot broth, and toppings like eggs, scallions, and sliced pork.

image.alt: Shoyu Ramen plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Gyoza
recipes.description: Japanese pan-fried dumplings with crisp bottoms and juicy filling.

steps.instruction: Mix the pork with finely chopped cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and seasonings.
Fill and pleat the wrappers into small crescent dumplings.
Pan-fry until golden, add a splash of water, cover to steam, and finish uncovered.

image.alt: Gyoza plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Crisp fried rolls filled with cabbage, carrots, and aromatics.

steps.instruction: Stir-fry the vegetables briefly with soy sauce and sesame oil, then let the filling cool.
Roll the filling tightly in the wrappers and seal the edges.
Fry until golden and crisp, then drain well before serving.

image.alt: Vegetable Spring Rolls plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: A fast stir-fry of chicken, chilies, peanuts, and a glossy savory sauce.

steps.instruction: Marinate the chicken briefly and stir-fry it until nearly cooked.
Add the chilies, scallions, and sauce ingredients and cook until glossy.
Stir in the peanuts right at the end and serve hot.

image.alt: Kung Pao Chicken plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: A quick wok-fried rice with eggs, scallions, and soy sauce.

steps.instruction: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set them aside.
Stir-fry the rice until the grains separate, then season with soy sauce.
Return the eggs to the wok with scallions and toss everything together.

image.alt: Egg Fried Rice plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Silken tofu and minced meat simmered in a spicy, savory bean sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown the pork and fry it briefly with the bean paste and aromatics.
Add the tofu gently with a little water or stock and simmer carefully.
Thicken lightly with cornstarch slurry and finish with scallions.

image.alt: Mapo Tofu plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
recipes.description: A fragrant Moroccan braise with olives, spices, and bright preserved lemon.

steps.instruction: Brown the chicken lightly and soften the onions with the spices.
Add water, preserved lemon, and olives, then braise until the chicken is very tender.
Reduce the sauce slightly and serve with bread or couscous.

image.alt: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Vegetable Couscous
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous with a broth of vegetables and chickpeas.

steps.instruction: Cook the vegetables and chickpeas in the stock with the spices until tender.
Steam or hydrate the couscous until fluffy.
Serve the vegetables and broth over the couscous.

image.alt: Vegetable Couscous plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Zaalouk
recipes.description: A smoky eggplant and tomato dip served warm or at room temperature.

steps.instruction: Cook the eggplant until very soft, then mash it roughly.
Simmer it with tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and cumin until the mixture thickens.
Serve with bread, warm or cooled.

image.alt: Zaalouk plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Moroccan Mint Tea
recipes.description: Sweet green tea infused with fresh mint.

steps.instruction: Rinse the tea briefly, then brew it in hot water.
Add the mint and sugar and let the tea infuse a little longer.
Pour from height into small glasses and serve hot.

image.alt: Moroccan Mint Tea plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Falafel
recipes.description: Crisp chickpea fritters flavored with herbs, spices, and garlic.

steps.instruction: Pulse the chickpeas with onion, herbs, garlic, and spices until the mixture is finely chopped but not pureed.
Shape the mixture into balls or patties and let it firm slightly.
Fry until deeply golden and crisp outside while keeping the inside tender.

image.alt: Falafel plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
recipes.description: A herb-driven salad with bulgur, tomatoes, parsley, and lemon.

steps.instruction: Soak or cook the bulgur according to the package and let it cool.
Finely chop the herbs and tomatoes.
Toss everything with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

image.alt: Tabbouleh plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Baba Ghanoush
recipes.description: A smoky eggplant dip blended with tahini, lemon, and garlic.

steps.instruction: Roast the eggplants until collapsed and smoky, then scoop out the flesh.
Blend or mash the eggplant with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and flatbread.

image.alt: Baba Ghanoush plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
recipes.description: Battered white fish with thick-cut fries and malt vinegar.

steps.instruction: Cut and fry or roast the potatoes until crisp and golden.
Make a batter with flour and cold beer or sparkling water and coat the fish.
Fry the fish until the batter is crunchy and the flesh flakes easily.

image.alt: Fish and Chips plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: A baked casserole of savory minced lamb under a blanket of mashed potatoes.

steps.instruction: Cook the lamb with the vegetables until lightly browned and savory.
Make a smooth mash with the potatoes and butter.
Top the meat filling with the mash and bake until the top is golden.

image.alt: Shepherd's Pie plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
recipes.description: A moist date sponge served with a warm toffee sauce.

steps.instruction: Soften the dates in hot water and blend them into a thick paste.
Make the sponge batter with butter, sugar, eggs, flour, and the date mixture, then bake until springy.
Cook the toffee sauce and pour it over the warm pudding.

image.alt: Sticky Toffee Pudding plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pho Bo
recipes.description: A fragrant beef noodle soup with herbs, rice noodles, and warming spices.

steps.instruction: Simmer the stock with the spices and aromatics until deeply fragrant.
Cook the rice noodles separately and divide them between bowls.
Arrange the raw beef over the noodles, pour over the hot broth, and finish with herbs and sprouts.

image.alt: Pho Bo plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Banh Mi
recipes.description: A crisp baguette sandwich with savory filling, pickled vegetables, and herbs.

steps.instruction: Cook the meat with a savory marinade until browned and juicy.
Split the baguettes and spread with mayonnaise or pate if using.
Fill with the meat, pickles, cucumber, and cilantro.

image.alt: Banh Mi plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Fresh Vietnamese Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Rice-paper rolls packed with herbs, noodles, and shrimp or tofu.

steps.instruction: Cook the noodles and shrimp or tofu, then let everything cool.
Soften each rice paper wrapper briefly in water.
Roll with noodles, herbs, and filling, then serve with the dipping sauce.

image.alt: Fresh Vietnamese Spring Rolls plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.description: A Korean rice bowl topped with vegetables, beef, egg, and chili paste.

steps.instruction: Cook the vegetables separately so each keeps its color and texture.
Brown the beef with a little soy sauce and sesame oil and fry the eggs.
Assemble the rice bowls with the toppings and mix with gochujang before eating.

image.alt: Bibimbap plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Bulgogi
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in soy, pear, garlic, and sesame.

steps.instruction: Marinate the beef with soy sauce, pear, garlic, and sesame oil.
Cook the beef quickly in a very hot pan so it browns without overcooking.
Serve with rice and lettuce leaves.

image.alt: Bulgogi plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: A fast, savory fried rice built around ripe kimchi and a fried egg.

steps.instruction: Stir-fry the kimchi first so it caramelizes slightly.
Add the rice and gochujang and fry until hot and well combined.
Top each serving with a fried egg and a few drops of sesame oil.

image.alt: Kimchi Fried Rice plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Feijoada
recipes.description: A Brazilian black bean stew enriched with pork and served with rice.

steps.instruction: Cook the black beans until tender while separately browning the pork and sausage.
Combine everything with onion and garlic and simmer slowly until rich and thick.
Serve with rice and orange wedges to cut the richness.

image.alt: Feijoada plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Brigadeiro
recipes.description: Brazilian chocolate fudge truffles rolled in chocolate sprinkles.

steps.instruction: Cook the condensed milk, cocoa, and butter over low heat until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the pan.
Cool the mixture until it is firm enough to handle.
Roll into small balls and coat with chocolate sprinkles.

image.alt: Brigadeiro plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Caipirinha
recipes.description: A bright Brazilian cocktail of cachaca, lime, and sugar.

steps.instruction: Cut the lime into wedges and muddle it with the sugar in a sturdy glass.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Pour in the cachaca and stir well.

image.alt: Caipirinha plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Ceviche
recipes.description: Fresh fish cured in lime juice with onion, chili, and herbs.

steps.instruction: Cut the fish into small cubes and chill it well.
Toss with lime juice, onion, chili, and cilantro until the fish turns opaque on the surface.
Serve immediately while bright and cold.

image.alt: Ceviche plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Lomo Saltado
recipes.description: A Peruvian stir-fry of beef, onion, tomato, and fries.

steps.instruction: Sear the beef very quickly over high heat so it keeps color and tenderness.
Add the onion, tomato, and soy sauce and toss briefly.
Fold in the fries at the end and serve with rice.

image.alt: Lomo Saltado plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Pisco Sour
recipes.description: A frothy cocktail of pisco, lime, sugar, and bitters.

steps.instruction: Shake the pisco, lime juice, syrup, and egg white hard without ice first.
Add ice and shake again until the drink is very cold and foamy.
Strain into a chilled glass and finish with bitters.

image.alt: Pisco Sour plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Menemen
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with tomatoes, peppers, and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Cook the peppers and tomatoes in olive oil until the tomatoes soften into a sauce.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until softly set.
Serve immediately with bread.

image.alt: Menemen plated and ready to serve

recipes.name: Mercimek Corbasi
recipes.description: A smooth Turkish red lentil soup brightened with lemon.

steps.instruction: Saute the onion and carrot with the tomato paste until fragrant.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer until the lentils are falling apart.
Blend until smooth and serve with lemon.

image.alt: Mercimek Corbasi plated and ready to serve
